leaf_cluster_summaries.summary: Walmart reports its slowest US sales growth in over 6 years, missing expectations with a 2.6% rise in comp sales amid lower pharmacy pricing.
Kwon Min-soo has been named Senior Deputy Governor of the Bank of Korea.
Ethereum (ETH) price experiences a rapid increase, moving from $1900 to $2300.
Bitcoin price surges toward $72,000, up significantly from $64,000 the previous morning.
Market update showing flat stocks with specific movements in TLT, USO, IBIT, GLD, EWY, and EEM.
Market commentary suggests the US dollar may act as a release valve as the Treasury seeks to control the long end of the yield curve.
Comparison of US debt compound annual growth rates across recent presidential administrations, highlighting trends under Bush, Obama, Trump, and Biden.
The 30-year Treasury yield is reported at 5.22%, having ranged between 5.16% and 5.33% for the month.
Commentary highlights the 'Pindia Challenge' as a stark geopolitical warning to Western nations.
Canada CFIB Business Barometer reports conflicting August figures of 57.6 and 57.8 across different sources.
The MOVE index, a measure of interest rate volatility, declines back toward the 70 level.
